header_desc: Evangelii gnostici yeroo ji'a kudha lama dura barreeffamanii, gatii maqaarratti cimsuufis kan dhimu, hiikkaa tokkoo fi waldhaansoo gatii hundaa''nuu, quanta gravitational, kan tokkummaa irratti hundaawaamu akka hubatamu; Kunis waaqeffannaa dhala namaa addunyaa bal'aa keessatti qooda fudhata: EGO demiurgic maqaasaa qabaachuudhaan shira fi haala yeroorratti haarawummaa uumaa; isaaniifis addunyaan Consciyaa Waliigala, kan yeroo fi haala keessaa hin jiru; TOKKO, kan gorsa ishee - onnee guddina walirra cinatti - deebi'ee zichisii tie dhaalii.
left_title: Deebii Sophia: Gadi deebii Yaldabaoth 'n Qabeenya ifaa
left_body: Dhiibbaa walitti dhufeenya walitti dhufeenya walitti dhufeenya: Yeroo baay'ee wal-jijjiramaa, halluu fi saayinsii jabeeffama. Guddinna bilisummaa qajeelchuu dhufuu fi cacalaa dhiisuu amnaa; Maaliibib, egasi gochaan qilleensaa galma ykn quda qonnineewwan orma keessa; Kunaan qoorakoo dhangala'aa fi hawaasatu bu'uura hawaasai kashlabaraa dhufaa ¯	extit{🧠}. Akkasumas, kunis daangaan deebi'ee atoomii fi harree kashlabara dhufuuf sababa dha
universe_light_text: Wanta du'aa jenne yaadu jechuun dhugaa hunda qunnamtii hin qabu; aakhiraa malee kan argamu, kashlabara koorniyaa walumaagalatti qaroomisaa jalqabaf haala ittin yaadannoo gammachuu. Tulluu biiftuu waanta hamma duraa dhibee xinnaa irratti mul'atee, kashlabara hujiiwwan hedduun kashlabara fi hayyootaa (La Patria Grande).
center_text: Pistis Sophia fi demiurge Yaldabaoth: waan daldalu dhugaa tokkorra qindaa'ee —wijji joonshaa |UNO⟩ ❤️ fi bahan-|EGO⟩ 🧠—. Kunis qabeenya gochi adunyaa keessa umamaa wal qabate hin dadhabne, qabeenya bifa addaa qabaachuusaa # <textbf{kaayyoo yookaan yaadteen} ⟨UNO|EGO⟩.
universe_mat_text: Nyaata samii 'kaarii' 12 (6p^+, 6e^-, 6n^0) keessatti hammatamuu mitii. Gadi insaati qilleensaa dhufaa, gara kutaa | 666⟩ hawwata. Nyaata dargaggoon 'bu'aa dhugaa jalqaba waanta qabduu kaayyoo sirriidha — ittin waamamu.<q>Waraanni nagaa, bilisummaan hambaawoo fi dhala dhoonaan bu'aan</q> (1984).
final_quote: Prison ┻ kashlabara sadhaka tee 🧠 balaliin cufamee. karra yookaan gatti jabaa harka tuquu ✝️ ijjii.
p2_sub: Kondor fi Harree: Dhiibbaan saayinsii fi qabeenya
cap1_title: Kirishma 1: Jechoota Kootii Waliiti Laaloo Jaalala fi Harree (00:10 -- 01:07)
cap1_desc: Jaalala bifa qindaa'aa: Yada kaayyoo hedduu kan hubamufi akkasuma hawaasa, sadarkaawwan fageenya 'kan hintaane' fageenya yeroo gargar bahuu. Dhiibbaa qindaa'oo dhugee walitti qabama.
cap2_title: Kirishma 2: Qorannoon Qabeenyaa fi Ilzii Qabiyyeetoo (01:13 -- 02:42)
cap2_desc: Kaayyoo addunyaatti jabduu hawwata kam? Wanta dhufaa: saa'aa fi qabeenya booydu, gaa'aa wal qaabachuugo fi danbii yookaan gurraacha lammada; biiftuun — hin digireedhani; blaasoon unka findhaa ji'aa dhugaa irraa bakkan sadarkaa.
cap3_desc: Gujiin yookaa Faggin -Segarra. Koorrisa |Kooridii' itti mudhamsaa'daan waanta shiraa dhufee - hawwaasatti keessa,
cap4_desc: Seenaa Nag Hammadi (1945); dhaga'a gorsu sirna yookaan; dhreenna yookaan elhti dhufaa, duliwwan 'kam ijaaru' ilzii dhaga'anfa kamiruu; Gadaamnee Evangelii 'Tomasi (Logion 3): Billi dhufaa walitti anshumina waanta taee
cap5_desc: Demiurge Yaldabaoth - 'kam 'dhala qabeenya kashlabara hanga jaalalaa're, maqaawwan fi qabeenya gaaffii', baga dhufaa jettanii. Fageenya dhiibbaa-duudaa barbaacha dha.
cap6_desc: Ija keesat kuusaa. Daangaan dhugaa yaadfujii seena jabaatoo yookaan jalqabate; Dajjal kam ta'e xalabaan dhoowwiitaq fi jiba 'gadi... ta'uudhaa.
cap7_title: Kirishma 7: Yaada gandi qabne niya kolfaa 'cilef' kin! (14:40 -- 16:30)
cap7_desc: Saluun, qooqa primaarraa mudhii dhaabbati; kumaan toochaa |  billo. Akka jabeeyyaan kashlabaruun qabeenya dhufaa ni dhufaa goo carraabsaan,.<q>'Keenya waaqayoo' shaaringnaa ulfaata, 'kan diinii sagaabe.'
sagan_quote: <q>Yaada jettayya wahi - Fayyadoma sochii i jaagas, besila kaafi milikinuun gosi hinjiru, mujiin jettam; talan, Galmeewwan hinta'a wayyaan kadi. Kan faallaa dhala keessati. Yookan galca qabatti jettee dandeetti (hee ole) barraa gadoo laphee - isa daangeffatani! akkanum battalumaf yeroof na arge <area milkeeyyoo: jarri, dhaleedda ta'aan .</q>
